audience: marketers and small businesses who text and email subscribers with Trumpia

useCases.title: Check text credits and scheduled messages
useCases.text: The AI reads the remaining domestic and international text credits, and lists the messages that are scheduled but not yet sent.

useCases.title: Review your lists and keywords
useCases.text: The AI lists distribution lists with their subscription, mobile and email counts, and the mobile keywords with their auto-response messages.

useCases.title: Find a contact and see which lists they are on
useCases.text: The AI searches subscriptions by email, mobile number or name, then opens one to read its details and list ids.

useCases.title: See how a message performed
useCases.text: The AI reads the delivery statistics of a sent message: status, totals, and sent and failed counts per channel. It can check the outcome of an earlier write request.

useCases.title: Add or update contacts and lists
useCases.text: The AI adds contacts to distribution lists, changes a contact's name, email, mobile or list membership, and creates or updates a list.

useCases.title: Send a message or cancel a scheduled one
useCases.text: The AI sends an SMS or email to lists or contacts, now or later, or one direct SMS, or cancels a scheduled message. Sent messages cannot be recalled.
